title: Single molecule force measurements reveal energy stabilization of theophylline aptamer RNA switch required for gene control
reader_choice: Sampled exports: corr(Force 1x, Force 2x) = -0.991 to -0.999 (equal and opposite dual-trap forces); Force 2x is positive and rises with Distance 1 in the -fd marker (0.1 -> 18.3 pN). Checked 2026-10-15.
